description.default: Client script: get notified when an AI turn finishes — push via 7 channels (ServerChan / PushPlus / Bark / DingTalk / WeCom / Telegram / Feishu), chime and in-app toast. Also watches background conversations: a turn finishing while you are in another conversation still notifies. Settings open from the bell button next to the todo list button in the top bar.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：一轮 AI 回复结束时提醒 —— 7 渠道推送（Server酱 / PushPlus / Bark / 钉钉 / 企业微信 / Telegram / 飞书）+ 提示音 + 应用内提示条。支持后台会话：切到其他会话时，原会话跑完同样提醒。设置入口在顶栏待办列表旁的铃铛按钮。
